I'm just sitting here at a (6) and am enjoying my relatively new purchase of an Extreme Q. I thought I'd share some research I've done and my impressions of the device, because there may be some interest.

General

It's a vaporizer that can fill bags, or have a whip attached to it. This video basically made up my mind about buying it, and may I just say I love British ents?

Impressions

First off, in the 12+ years I've been an Ent, I've been exposed to quite a bit of different things over the years, I made the switch to oil only about 3 years ago, and from then the heated nail and various pens have been a staple. I honestly thought that there was no better way to smoke weed. But as it turns out I was wrong.

Now, I've been exposed to volcanos, and frankly I'm not a fan. The taste is good, but the units are (or must be) difficult to clean, because I've never had one from a clean unit. And that's the first point the Arizer scores. I've had mine for a month, and I just cleaned all the pieces of the unit. A little 180 proof Kentucky moon on the removable pieces and stoppered in the hose, then rinsed the hose with a little orange juice (or lemon), rinse thoroughly with water, and use a q tip to get a bit of the dust on the inside and the unit is new. Easier to clean this than some glass pieces I've had.

In terms of taste... wow! Numerous old ents have been over to try it, and 2 of my friends have ordered one. I've heard numerous times (and think myself) that this is the tastiest way of smoking. For bags I typically pack up a loosely packed bowl with ~4 dabs of honey oil in the center (half pack/oil/half pack). I use 375 for the temp for the first 2 bags, then typically use a whip at 500 to roast the rest. It remains a powerful hitter for quite a while, and the dab mixing in preserves the taste even when the bowl looks pretty cooked.

Another plus is when smoking alone you can even pack it up completely differently for conservative method. I usually put a dab in the center of this as well which extends it to 5 amazing hits at 500 degrees. This is probably the most economical use of my product that I've ever had, my over all consumption has gone down, and my enjoyment is up.

Mods

This sadly is incomplete. I'm ~3 days out from receiving my mod kit, which I discovered here. I really wish I could comment on that section because I've found a really really good link for the mod they're talking about. The DDave mod kit plus. Is all the those individual pieces they're talking about in one super convient package. It's one of the first results when you google 'arizer extreme q mod' and most of those links are broken as hell. Anyways I stumbled upon the complete kit, and figured I'd try to save someone out there the time and trouble of finding the complete mod kit. I asked for the Silver Surfer attachment (it says on the site it'll do either the Buddha or Surfer you can request it in the notes). Supposedly this is will get my product closer to the heat source, widen the airflow, and more evenly roast the product. I'll let y'all know how that works out on Wednesday (if I can even think).

TL;DR: You should get an Extreme Q or other vape if you haven't already. Vaping rules.
Arizer Extreme Q - My impressions and mods

I have one of those vapes and it's the shit. I like to set mine at 230c and let the buds/oil sit in it for a few minutes to warm up with the glass a little as it gets considerably more vapor out of the product. The bags are great and all I really use these days but holy hell that first draw on the whip is to die for. That taste and stone are second to none but I have chosen to stick with the bags due to their mobility and general convenience plus with super tasty gear it only puts a dent in the flavour instead of diluting it to shit.

10/10 would recommend.
